newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen taking breather after rally.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen taking breather after rally.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: DRAINAGE OF 400 BLN YEN

*Key September 10-year JGB futures expected to be range-bound on Tuesday, with upside seen capped due to likely selling interest at recent high levels, traders said. *Little impact expected from EPA economic report due in morning, given recent gap between market views and EPA views on Japanese economy.
